title: Naturality of squares normalized by right-derived units
statement: Let F and G be additive functors between abelian categories with chosen derived categories and K-injective resolutions. Let two squares from F to G be normalized by their right-derived units, with specified localized horizontal functors and factorization isomorphisms. Any morphism of the ordinary squares compatible with those localization factorizations induces the same commuting square of natural transformations on the derived categories. The precise equation and hypotheses are given by the Lean declaration.

source.place: Tag 0D6E, uniqueness of right-derived functors and naturality of derived-composition comparisons.

proof.text: Precompose the two candidate transformations on a K-injective representative by the image of the source derived unit and postcompose by the target factorization isomorphism. Substitute the two square normalizations and the two localization-factorization equations. The ordinary commuting-square equation and naturality of the target derived unit identify these composites. The source unit is invertible on K-injectives. Every derived object is isomorphic to such a representative, so naturality extends the equality to the whole category.

from.place: Imported Proof Step 2 (Qbar-stage), independence of finite coefficient extension; Proof steps 7 and 8: compatibility of coefficient routes and actual semilinear transitions.

lean.statement:
theorem normalized_naturality
    (x' : A ⥤ Ap) (y' : B ⥤ Bp) [x'.Additive] [y'.Additive]
    (X X' : DerivedCategory.{w} A ⥤ DerivedCategory.{w} Ap)
    (Y Y' : DerivedCategory.{w} B ⥤ DerivedCategory.{w} Bp)
    (xf : DerivedCategory.Q ⋙ X ≅ x.mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ) ⋙ DerivedCategory.Q)
    (xf' : DerivedCategory.Q ⋙ X' ≅ x'.mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ) ⋙ DerivedCategory.Q)
    (yf : DerivedCategory.Q ⋙ Y ≅ y.mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ) ⋙ DerivedCategory.Q)
    (yf' : DerivedCategory.Q ⋙ Y' ≅ y'.mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ) ⋙ DerivedCategory.Q)
    (c : F ⋙ y ⟶ x ⋙ G) (c' : F ⋙ y' ⟶ x' ⋙ G)
    (b : F.rightDerivedFunctor ⋙ Y ⟶ X ⋙ G.rightDerivedFunctor)
    (b' : F.rightDerivedFunctor ⋙ Y' ⟶ X' ⋙ G.rightDerivedFunctor)
    (hn : unitNormalized F G x y X Y xf yf c b)
    (hn' : unitNormalized F G x' y' X' Y' xf' yf' c' b')
    (a : x ⟶ x') (d : y ⟶ y') (ad : X ⟶ X') (dd : Y ⟶ Y')
    (ha : ∀ I : CochainComplex A ℤ,
      ad.app (DerivedCategory.Q.obj I) ≫ xf'.hom.app I =
        xf.hom.app I ≫ DerivedCategory.Q.map
          ((NatTrans.mapHomologicalComplex a (.up ℤ)).app I))
    (hd : ∀ I : CochainComplex B ℤ,
      dd.app (DerivedCategory.Q.obj I) ≫ yf'.hom.app I =
        yf.hom.app I ≫ DerivedCategory.Q.map
          ((NatTrans.mapHomologicalComplex d (.up ℤ)).app I))
    (hc : ∀ M : A, d.app (F.obj M) ≫ c'.app M = c.app M ≫ G.map (a.app M)) :
    Functor.whiskerLeft F.rightDerivedFunctor dd ≫ b' =
      b ≫ Functor.whiskerRight ad G.rightDerivedFunctor
